purpose: Imported source inventory for the executable static benchmark. Labels describe scoped technical facts, not legal verdicts about the original projects.

validation.sourceReview: Pinned public source and license declarations inspected; imported excerpts carry per-case review rationale.
validation.staticProbes: 100 source groups run as strict benchmark cases. The 88 additions are scoped source-excerpt cases with exact text and structural checks.
validation.liveRuntime: Not exercised; complete applications, SDKs and browser consent lifecycles remain outside excerpt cases.

labelPolicy: Expected fields describe scoped technical facts only. A positive PDN rule label requires separate manual justification; omitted rules must not be scored. Current detector output must not define expected labels.
independencePolicy: One provisional source group per independently developed repository. Check shared implementation ancestry before import. Translations, generated output, state variants and multiple apps in one monorepo do not create new independent sources.
